title: Capsule Lens: Locating and Tracking Concept Geometry in Model Representations
abstract: arXiv:2609.05575v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding how concepts are encoded in the internal representations of machine learning models is a central problem in mechanistic interpretability, essential both for the science of deep learning and for the trustworthy deployment of increasingly capable models. Existing approaches to interpret model representations mainly map representations onto more interpretable spaces and do not directly characterize how concepts occupy representation space; various hypotheses have been proposed, but often lack of rigorous validation and largely focus on static representations. In this work, we introduce Capsule Lens, a framework that matches the region a concept occupies with a simple, trackable geometric form, a capsule, defined by several interpretable parameters, fitted in closed form to each concept's geometry and validated on held-out samples. translated_title: 胶囊透镜：在模型表示中定位与追踪概念几何结构
translated_abstract: 理解概念如何编码在机器学习模型的内部表示中，是机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）领域的核心问题，这对于深度学习的科学研究以及日益强大的模型的可信部署都至关重要。现有的模型表示解释方法主要将表示映射到更可解释的空间中，并未直接刻画概念如何占据表示空间；尽管已有多种假设被提出，但往往缺乏严格的验证，且大多聚焦于静态表示。在本工作中，我们提出了Capsule Lens，这是一个将概念所占区域与一种简单、可追踪的几何形状——胶囊（capsule）——相匹配的框架。该胶囊由若干可解释的参数定义，以闭式形式拟合到每个概念的几何结构上，并在留出样本上进行了验证。我们将Capsule Lens应用于两大场景：静态表示和动态表示。在静态表示上……
tldr: 提出Capsule Lens框架，通过闭式拟合由可解释参数定义的胶囊几何形状，来定位和追踪机器学习模型表示中概念的几何结构，并可同时应用于静态与动态表示场景。
en_tdlr: Capsule Lens is a framework that locates and tracks concept geometry in model representations by fitting capsules, defined by interpretable parameters, in closed form to each concept's geometry, validated on held-out samples across both static and dynamic representations.
